evaluation.rationale: The opening dialogue and camera shot immediately set a tense atmosphere, while the explosion and ensuing chaos create a high-stakes, emotionally charged scene. The final close-up on Juliana's face, showing a range of emotions, leaves the audience eager to see what happens next.
evaluation.hook_evidence: "Nothing." Medium shot of the elderly Priest opening the leather-bound liturgical book between Rupert and Catherine.
evaluation.cliffhanger_evidence: Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.
